_how: Once a retailer approves you (Commission Factory, Impact, Partnerize, Rakuten, Awin), paste its deep-link template here keyed by domain. {url} = URL-encoded product link, {raw_url} = plain. Every product link on the site, RSS and alerts is rewritten automatically on the next scan.
_direct_links_help: Exact original retailer URL -> complete tracking link copied from your approved account. Used for opted-in directory links. No API secrets or fabricated IDs.
